name: track-lab
description: Experimental research and workflow plugins from track-lab.

plugins.name: memory
plugins.description: Persistent agent memory and consolidation (dream) backed by a track vault.

plugins.name: note
plugins.description: Notes as the shared record between developer and agent: create, search, and maintain track notes, write track-flavored Markdown, clip web pages, record project work, file research reports that stay readable in Japanese, run multi-lens news analyses and recurring daily/weekly watch loops, fold a topic's reports into one explainer note, build single-file HTML tools a note can embed, and keep task plans and worklogs.
